name: Expert_ABE_BE_CCI
summary: This EA uses a CCI-based signal filter (CBE_BE_CCI) combined with a moving average to generate momentum-based trade entries and exits within the MetaQuotes standard expert framework. It employs fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop, relying entirely on the signal threshold mechanism for trade decisions. The strategy is built on the CExpert architecture with a single signal filter driving buy/sell decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用基于CCI的信号过滤器(CBE_BE_CCI)结合移动平均线，在MetaQuotes标准专家框架内生成基于动量的交易入场和出场信号。它采用固定手数仓位管理，无追踪止损，完全依赖信号阈值机制进行交易决策。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心是CBE_BE_CCI信号过滤器，它结合了CCI（商品通道指数，周期49）和MA（移动平均线，周期11）来判断市场动量方向。CCI指标用于识别价格偏离统计均值的程度，当CCI值超过开仓阈值40时产生入场信号，低于平仓阈值20时产生出场信号。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认手数为0.1，不根据账户余额动态调整。策略不使用追踪止损（CTrailingNone），出场完全依赖信号过滤器的阈值判断。挂单过期时间设为4根K线，限制了未成交订单的存续时间。整体而言，这是一个基于CCI动量振荡器的系统化交易策略，通过双阈值机制控制进出场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core of this strategy is the CBE_BE_CCI signal filter, which combines CCI (Commodity Channel Index, period 49) with a Moving Average (period 11) to determine market momentum direction. The CCI indicator identifies the degree of price deviation from its statistical mean, generating entry signals when the CCI value exceeds the open threshold of 40 and exit signals when it falls below the close threshold of 20. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. The strategy does not use a trailing stop (CTrailingNone), relying entirely on the signal filter's threshold mechanism for trade exits. Pending order expiration is set to 4 bars, limiting the lifespan of unexecuted orders. Overall, this is a systematic trading strategy based on the CCI momentum oscillator, using a dual-threshold mechanism to control entries and exits.
pros: 基于标准CExpert框架构建，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
CCI动量指标能有效识别趋势的启动和衰竭，具有一定的统计意义
双阈值机制（开仓40/平仓20）提供了进出场逻辑的灵活性，可避免频繁交易
pros_en: Built on the standard CExpert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
The CCI momentum indicator can effectively identify trend initiation and exhaustion with statistical significance
The dual-threshold mechanism (open at 40/close at 20) provides flexibility in entry/exit logic and helps avoid overtrading
cons: 止损和止盈水平均设为0，缺乏硬性风险保护，可能导致大幅亏损
无追踪止损机制，盈利头寸无法锁定浮动利润，可能回吐大量收益
固定手数不根据市场波动率或账户风险动态调整，资金管理较为粗糙
仅依赖单一CCI过滤器，缺乏多信号确认，容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: Both Stop Loss and Take Profit levels are set to 0, lacking hard risk protection which may lead to significant losses
No trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions cannot lock in floating profits, potentially giving back substantial gains
Fixed lot sizing does not dynamically adjust based on market volatility or account risk, making money management coarse
Relies on a single CCI filter without multi-signal confirmation, prone to generating false signals
improvements: 添加非零的止损和止盈水平，或在信号过滤器中集成动态止损计算
引入追踪止损模块替代CTrailingNone，以保护已有利润
增加多时间框架确认或多信号过滤器组合，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add non-zero Stop Loss and Take Profit levels, or integrate dynamic stop-loss calculation within the signal filter
Introduce a trailing stop module to replace CTrailingNone for protecting accrued profits
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or combine multiple signal filters to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，无硬性风险控制，单笔交易可能造成重大损失
无新K线检查机制（Expert_EveryTick=false但非真正的新bar检测），可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
固定手数缺乏风控弹性，在极端行情下无法自适应调整仓位
risk_points_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit are both 0, meaning no hard risk control exists and a single trade could cause major losses
No new bar check mechanism (Expert_EveryTick=false is not true new bar detection), potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Fixed lot sizing lacks risk control flexibility and cannot adaptively adjust positions during extreme market conditions

It employs fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop, relying entirely on the signal threshold mechanism for trade decisions. The strategy is built on the CExpert architecture with a single signal filter driving buy/sell decisions.
